title: 'Thank you so much for the best weekend ever': The id Software gang got together at QuakeCon, and it sure looks like everyone had a great time

body: The recently concluded QuakeCon was a big one, marking the 30th anniversary of the game that started it all and, more notably, bringing id Software co-founders Adrian Carmack, John Carmack, Tom Hall, and John Romero together for the first time in a very long time. I had wondered, in the lead-up to the event, if it might get a little awkward or uncomfortable: Differences between the Johns were " over-dramatized " over the years, according to Romero Games co-founder Brenda Romero, but Adrian Carmack filed a lawsuit over his removal from the studio back in 2005, and other internal conflicts over the years led to the dismissal of well-liked employees like American McGee and Paul Steed. The more recent layoffs of Xbox that left the studio in varying states of " gutted ," depending on who you ask, also threatened to overshadow the whole thing. So, you know: you wonder . Now that everything is wrapped up, I'm happy to report that if there was any awkwardness or discomfort between the studio's famed founders, everyone kept it to themselves and they all seemed to have a really good time. Darrah reckons that's a direct result of Larian's willingness to do its own thing with the sequel.
